item.title: Korg 800DV (Maxi-KORG) Analog Duophonic Synthesizer SN 760121
item.description: via this eBay listing "Excellent condition, not gigged, smoke free environment. A popular duophonic/monophonic classic from Korg. It's got 2 analog oscillators that can be used for one fat monophonic sound or 2 VCO's per voice for a fat duophonic sound. Flexible design with 2 voltage controlled filters and even a ring modulator. Check out this review by GForce Software:" [posted here]
